metadata.evidence: Our proposed model combines a Generative Adversarial Network with a classifier to leverage artifical GAN generations to increase the size of restricted, fully-supervised datasets in a semi-supervised method.
metadata.reason: States the primary purpose of the model.

metadata.evidence: We therefore, propose a novel GAN model namely External Classifier GAN (EC-GAN), that utilizes GANs and semi-supervised algorithms to improve classification in fully-supervised regimes.
metadata.reason: Explicitly names and characterizes the proposed method.
